summary: Sandbach United played an entertaining away fixture at Market Drayton in what appears to be an important cup tie, with the match finely poised at 2-2 after 25 minutes. Key performers included Kieran Nolan and Kieron O'Connell, who both got on the scoresheet, while Robbie Hatton opened the scoring with a well-taken header from a Cope corner. The Shropshire pitch presented a firm playing surface but The Bach will be looking to secure the away victory they need as the match continues.
